name: Zeresh
description: Woman living at the time of Exile and Return

points: Then Zeresh his wife and all his friends counselled that a gallows fifty cubits high be made, and on the morrow he should speak to the king that Mordecai be hanged thereon, and then go merrily to the banquet, and the thing pleased Haman and he caused the gallows to be made. It was the wife's idea, for the enemy's women are in cahoots with the work against Israel.

note.label: Esther 5: Esther Finds Favour and Haman Builds the Gallows
